question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The water at her place __was ____cool and had__ a metallic taste.
solution:
The correct answer is **No improvement required.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• No error lies in the given underlined sentence.
 
• The sentence is written in Past Tense.
 
• We use '**was**' for singular subjects and '**were**' for plural subjects.
 
• Also, if **1st sentence** is in **past form**, then **2nd sentence** will also be in the **past form**.
 
• Here subject "The water" is singular, hence we will use 'was' for this subject.
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'was cool and had__' in the sentence is absolutely correct.
 
• Hence, No improvement required.

 

*__Correct sentence__: The water at her place __was ____cool and had__ a metallic taste.*
